-- connect to psql
```bash
export PGPASSWORD=<POSTGRES_PASSWORD>; psql --host <POSTGRES_HOST> -p <POSTGRES_PORT> -U <POSTGRES_USERNAME>
```

-- load the sql generated by the pg_Admin ERD tool into the database named staging_olap_script
```psql CLI
\i olap_erd.sql
```
-- show the schema created
```psql CLI
\dt; \dn
```
